infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TeamLens records your location when you clock in, so your workplace can confirm attendance at the right site.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TeamLens records your route only while you are clocked in, so travel and visits are logged for your timesheet. Tracking stops the moment you clock out.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: TeamLens counts your steps while you are clocked in, so field work is reflected in your activity summary.
